summary: South Bow Corp (a foreign private issuer) furnished a Form 6-K containing a Notice of Reliance under Canadian NI 51-102 Section 13.4 for its 100%-owned subsidiary South Bow USA Infrastructure Holdings LLC, which relies on South Bow's continuous disclosure. The filing includes unaudited consolidating summary financial information for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, as required for credit support issuers. No transaction or special situation is present; it is a routine cross-border continuous disclosure filing.
